entries.title: A second crewmate checks an approved merge when its crewmate is unsure
entries.body: If a crewmate brings a change you approved up to date with your project and cannot tell whether that changed the work, a second crewmate compares the two. The merge goes ahead only if nothing but the update changed; otherwise you are asked again on a new card.
entries.noPicture: The only thing on screen is one Activity line and a short-lived crewmate; the change is who decides when a merge goes ahead.
